resume: Bio-synthetic groovebox for playing live and building songs without a computer: six tracks, several engines, a song generator and a section system, inherited from Felucca and SLOOP.

commandes.role: Keyboard octave down. In dialogs: back or NO.
Keyboard octave up. In dialogs: done or YES. Both together: octave 0.
FX section, module by module (TRACK, BUSES, DELAY, REVERB...). Held: live effects (punch-in).
Printed SCL in the docs. SCL section: KEY and CHORD. Held: the keys set the root.
LFO section: MOD, LFO, MSEQ. Held: macros, KNOB 1 to 4 are M1 to M4.
EDIT section (SOUND, TONE, FOCUS). Held: INIT, RECALL, DRUM-X mutes. Held + SELECT: sound dice.
GLO section: LIVE, MIX, GLOBAL, SYSTEM. Held: mutes, solos, levels, tap tempo, UNDO; + SELECT: tempo.
HOME page; press again for the groups ECO, BEING, GEN. Held 0.7 s: MENU; held + SELECT: the GEN song generator.
SAVE section: sounds, project (sections), library. Held: play or stow sections live.
Sequencer: STEP (piano roll), PATTERN, TRACK, BAR, AUTO. Held: SEQ tools.
Arms or disarms recording of the selected track. Held: CLEAR, CLICK.
Steps through the pages of the section, one page per detent.
Changes the track's sound (factory then user); on the SEQ pages, the patterns; in GEN, the genre.
Picks the track, T1 to T6 (T1 to T4 with TRACKS 4).
They play the selected track. Held buttons: shortcuts for the layer.

gestes: HOME held + SELECT: the GEN generator.
GLO held + G4: UNDO of the last big change.
A held step (SEQ, STEP) + KNOB 1 to 4: parameter lock on that step.
a_savoir: Little tested on a real FM-1 (preview version).
Felucca's user samples (USR1 to USR3) are lost on installation.
